### name: 🐛 缺陷报告 / Bug Report

---

### 描述缺陷 / Describe the Bug
**中文：** 请清晰、简洁地描述这个缺陷是什么。
**English:** Please provide a clear and concise description of what the bug is.

---

### 重现步骤 / Steps to Reproduce
**中文：** 复现该行为的步骤。
**English:** Steps to reproduce the behavior.

1. 进入 / Go to '...'
2. 点击 / Click on '....'
3. 滚动到 / Scroll down to '....'
4. 看到错误 / See error

---

### 预期行为 / Expected Behavior
**中文：** 请清晰、简洁地描述你预期会发生什么。
**English:** A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

---

### 截图 / Screenshots
**中文：** 如果适用，添加截图来帮助解释你的问题。
**English:** If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

---

### 日志文件 / Log File

> **中文：** 为了帮助我们定位问题，请在运行程序时加上 `--debug --logfile` 参数，并将生成的日志文件拖拽到下方的编辑框中，或点击上传。你可以参考我们的[如何获取调试日志指南](https://github.com/your-repo/wiki/debug-logs)来了解更多。
>
> **English:** To help us locate the issue, please run the program with the `--debug --logfile` flag and drag the generated log file into the editor below, or click to upload it. You can refer to our [Guide on How to Get Debug Logs](https://github.com/your-repo/wiki/debug-logs) for more details.
